caption: The drawing depicts an interior scene with an open wooden double door at the center, leading to an exterior space with greenery visible through the doorway. The floor consists of a red and light brown checkerboard pattern of square tiles, while the lower portion of the walls is painted a reddish-brown color with a zigzag border design. Above this, the walls transition to a pale, tan color, with two vertical sections of light blue rectangular bricks framing the door on either side. On the left wall, there is a small round decorative object with a spiky edge, placed above the border. The ceiling and upper wall area are painted with a gradient of muted tan and light brown shades, giving a textured appearance. Light enters the room from the open door, casting shadows on the tiled floor.
title: Doorway
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
